requirementsZh: 8+ 年机器人工程，扎实经典基础：动力学、运动学、控制理论（阻抗/导纳、全身控制）与状态估计
有量产硬件产品上线后经验：现场根因分析、固件发布与部署生命周期内持续改进（非仅预研）
仍 hands-on：定期编写与评审生产级固件/控制代码，而非只做架构文档
深度嵌入式/实时软件：RTOS 或 PREEMPT_RT、传感/执行驱动、实时调度与软硬件协同设计；安全关键行为（故障检测、降级、安全态）
机器人控制与规划：行走/操作/全身控制或同等领域；能在控制、感知与高层规划/AI 交界工作
跨域硬件理解（机械机构、PCB/电子、执行器、传感与布线），能主导跨机械/电气/固件根因并推动设计/工艺纠正
遥操作系统经验：低延迟远程操控、操作界面与会话数据管道
建设/扩展客户向技术支持（分诊、升级路径）与工程/现场培训；招聘并培养固件、控制与现场向工程师
requirementsEn: 8+ years robotics engineering with a strong classical foundation: dynamics, kinematics, control theory (impedance/admittance, whole-body control), and state estimation
Owned a shipped hardware product post-launch: field root-cause, firmware releases, and incremental improvement over the deployed life — not only pre-launch development
Still hands-on: writes and reviews production firmware/controls code regularly, not just architecture docs

Deep embedded/real-time software: RTOS or PREEMPT_RT, sensor/actuator drivers, real-time scheduling, hardware–software co-design; safety-critical behavior (fault detection, graceful degradation, safe-state)
Robot control and planning: locomotion, manipulation, whole-body control, or equivalent; comfortable at the controls / perception / higher-level planning–AI interface
Cross-disciplinary hardware literacy (mechanisms, PCB/electronics, actuators, sensors, wiring) to lead mech/EE/firmware root-cause and drive design or process corrective actions
Teleoperation experience: low-latency remote control, operator interfaces, and data pipelines from sessions to training data
Built or scaled customer-facing technical support (triage, escalation) and technical training; track record hiring/developing firmware, controls, and field-facing engineers
niceZh: 人形或其他复杂多自由度机器人经验
创业公司领导经验，理想为早期机器人工程负责人（从小团队扩展）
熟悉机器人常见算力/网络栈（如 Jetson 级边缘算力、EtherCAT、实时 Linux）
niceEn: Humanoid or other complex multi-DOF robotic systems
Prior startup leadership, ideally as an early robotics engineering leader scaling from single digits
Familiarity with typical robot compute/networking stacks (e.g. Jetson-class edge compute, EtherCAT, real-time Linux)
